project: Distributionally Robust and Regime-Aware Deep Hedging Under Market Frictions
device_notes: Scripts auto-detect device (MPS > CUDA > CPU). W-DRO-T needs a double-backward through attention; use CUDA (Colab) for speed. MPS ~18 min/market-seed for W-DRO-T; CUDA ~2-3 min.

models.RSE_fric: rse_improved.RSETrainerFrictionAware (deployment-friction / turnover-pressure training; pass-5 research variant)
models.RSE_rich: rse_improved.RegimeSwitchingEnsembleRich (9-d regime features; pass-5 research variant)

experiments.purpose: In-distribution Heston benchmark (paper Table 'main'); RSE lowest CVaR95
experiments.notes: --r 0 reproduces the reported Table 1 exactly (default is 0.05).

experiments.purpose: Regime-calibrated SPY/NIFTY stress battery, full-fidelity models (paper Table 'realmarket_full')
Causal walk-forward on raw OHLCV (paper Table 'walkforward'); LSTM/3SCH/RSE/WDROT, per-window PnL captured
Paired moving-block-bootstrap CVaR95 CIs on the walk-forward cells (closes small-n crisis weakness)
PRIORITY-1 research: adaptive vs constant Wasserstein radius, causal walk-forward
PRIORITY-2 research: RSE turnover-CVaR frontier via friction inflation (train_tc = k x deploy_tc)
experiments.command: for k in 1 2 3; do python wf_variants_pilot.py --which rse --only RSE_base,RSE_fric --seeds 42,142,242 --markets SPY,NIFTY --fric-mult $k --out wf_rse_fric_k$k.json; done

experiments.purpose: PRIORITY-2 research: richer 9-d regime features vs baseline 6-d (ablation)
experiments.command: python wf_variants_pilot.py --which rse --only RSE_base,RSE_rich --seeds 42,142,242 --markets SPY,NIFTY --out wf_rse_features.json

experiments.purpose: Whalley-Wilmott/Zakamouline gamma-vol-scaled no-trade-band overlay; turnover-CVaR frontier. Model-agnostic, inference-only.
experiments.command: python wf_band_pilot.py --seeds 42,142,242 --markets SPY,NIFTY --out wf_band_results.json && python analyze_band.py wf_band_results.json
experiments.finding: iso-CVaR turnover -30..-50% on low-friction (SPY); no CVaR help on high-friction NIFTY crisis (tail needs the trades).

experiments.purpose: Reviewer-flagged generalisation: train US(SPY) policy -> deploy India(NIFTY) crisis, and reverse. Frozen weights, destination friction.
experiments.command: python wf_cross_market.py --seeds 42,142,242 && python walk_forward_bootstrap.py --results wf_cross_market_results.json --ref LSTM --models LSTM,3SCH,RSE,WDROT --out wf_cross_market_bootstrap.json

experiments.purpose: Regression test: walk-forward features must not depend on future closes
